```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
iris = pd.read_csv('data/iris.csv')

# Create a pairplot to visualize the relationships between variables
sns.set(style="whitegrid")
pairplot = sns.pairplot(iris, hue='species', diag_kind='kde', palette='dark')

# Add title and adjust layout
pairplot.fig.suptitle("Iris Dataset - Pairplot of Sepal and Petal Dimensions", y=1.02)
pairplot.fig.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
